about_the_game:
Become Jude the Lawless in this adrenaline-fueled VR western experience.

Being Jude the Lawless is a wild west-themed VR roguelite where every run is a fight for survival. Armed with your revolver and grit, you’ll protect your hidden treasure from relentless waves of twisted creatures lurking in the dust.

Shoot fast, shoot smart — because death means starting over.

Earn gold from each successful defense.
Buy new weapons, upgrade your firepower, and unlock powerful gear.
Face evolving enemy waves that get tougher with every round.
Master the chaos of the untamed West in immersive VR combat.
Chase high scores, push your limits, and see how long you can survive.

Once known as "Captain Jude Callahan", he was one of the few officers to survive the bloodiest fronts of the civil war. Back then, the law stood behind him — now, Jude runs from it with no intention of looking back. After the war, Jude returned to his hometown, "BloodCreek", only to find it corrupted beyond recognition. Railroad tycoons, greedy land barons, and crooked sheriffs had crushed the people. And monster zombie attacks followed these. Jude strapped on his gun once more: But this time, not for the law… for justice. He became the last protector of "BloodCreek’s sacred chest", said to be entrusted only to the “Great Guardian.” No one knows what lies within — only that many died for it. When monstrous invaders fell from the sky with a black star, Jude took a stand. The sky cracked open. Red mist spread. Inhuman screams echoed. Whatever slept beneath BloodCreek had awakened. Humanity fled. Jude stayed. For seven long years, he never left the chest’s side. Now…

YOU ARE Jude The Lawless.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480

  • VR Support: SteamVR or Oculus PC
